# `date_format`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
date_format(timestamp, fmt)
```

Converts `timestamp` to a value of string in the format specified by the date format `fmt`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT date_format('2016-04-08', 'y');
```

Result:

```text
2016
```
